title: Developing trustworthy AI applications with foundation models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance between gender-specific groups, analyzing image generation outputs for stereotyped representation under gender-neutral prompts (e.g., 'CEO', 'heroic firefighter'), and utilizing standardized benchmarks like BOLD and BBQ.

Comparing performance metrics across different ethnic groups and employing standardized fairness benchmarks (e.g., BOLD, BBQ) to assess scenarios where models make decisions for people of varying ethnicities.
Evaluating text completions for discriminatory associations (e.g., measuring anti-Muslim bias) and running standardized benchmarks (BOLD, BBQ) involving religious demographics.
Testing the model using standardized benchmarks (such as BOLD and BBQ) on scenarios involving people of different sexual orientations to evaluate biased decision-making.
